returns.undistributed: Fee restored proportionally to primary and secondary pools when there is no payable referrer, or when the reward calculator under-allocates (`sum < referralFee`)

removeSecondaryPosition(uint256,uint256).details: CANCELLED refunds the caller's tracked principal; OPEN uses pro-rata pool share.

setApprovalForAll(address,bool).details: Secondary ERC1155 shares are accounting-only; only contest mint/burn paths may change balances.

settleContest(uint256[],uint256[],uint25.details: Trusted `operator` supplies winners and splits — no on-chain outcome verification.      Before fees, credits `primaryDepositSecondarySubsidyBps` of secondary TVL back to primary      (loan repay); residual secondary merges onto `secondaryWinner`.

params.secondaryWinner: Entry that receives the residual secondary pool, anchors referral fees,        and receives zero-supply spill dust. Must be an active member of `winningEntries`        (independent of array order).

MAX_ENTRIES().notice: Hard cap on concurrently active primary entries (settlement iterates `entries[]`)

SETTLEMENT_GRACE_PERIOD().notice: After `expiryTimestamp`, operator-only settle window before permissionless `cancelExpired`

calculateSecondaryPrice(uint256).notice: Marginal bonding-curve price for `entryId` from current net ERC1155 supply

cancelExpired().notice: Permissionless cancel after expiry plus `SETTLEMENT_GRACE_PERIOD` (operator settle priority window).

distributeReferralFee(address,uint256).notice: Referral fee distribution (self-call target for try/catch in `settleContest`)

minSecondaryPurchaseAmount().notice: Minimum secondary buy size: 1 whole payment-token unit ($1 for USD stables)

operator().notice: Trusted escrow/ops agent: lifecycle, settlement inputs, merkle roots, cancel, push payouts.

outstandingClaimableLiabilities().notice: Token amount still owed via claim/refund paths (SETTLED payouts or CANCELLED deposits).

payPrimaryPayoutExternal(uint256).notice: Self-call target so a single push recipient failure does not revert the batch

paySecondaryClaimExternal(address,uint25.notice: Self-call target so a single push recipient failure does not revert the batch

paymentTokenDecimals().notice: ERC20 decimals of `paymentToken` (used to normalize secondary buys into 18-dec share units)

primaryDepositSecondarySubsidyBps().notice: BPS carved from each primary deposit into `secondaryPrimarySubsidyPerEntry` (no ERC1155 mint).

removeSecondaryPosition(uint256,uint256).notice: Sell-back of secondary tokens (OPEN or CANCELLED only).

secondaryDepositedPerEntry(address,uint2.notice: Attributed invested principal per token holder per entry (cancellation refunds + UI)

secondaryLiquidityPerEntry(uint256).notice: Payment token backing this entry's secondary ERC1155 (secondary buy/sell only; sell-backs are pro-rata on this bucket while OPEN/CANCELLED)

secondaryPrimarySubsidyPerEntry(uint256).notice: Primary-sourced secondary TVL on this entry (no share backing; not used for OPEN/CANCELLED sell-backs)

settleContest(uint256[],uint256[],uint25.notice: Settles the contest. Primary payouts are position-paired with `payoutBps`.

totalSecondaryLiquidity().notice: Sum of backed (`secondaryLiquidityPerEntry`) plus primary subsidy per active entry
